en.t: It must look completely new now, I suppose.

units.source_text: 不过，塔没被烧掉……是按原来的模样拆掉重建的。

en.t: But the tower was not burned down... it was dismantled and rebuilt just as it had been before.

units.source_text: 落成典礼正好赶上樱花盛开时节，一定会招来许多人的。”

en.t: The completion ceremony will come right when the cherry blossoms are in full bloom, so it is sure to draw many people.
